section.status: Your state right now: the modes that are on, where you stand and how many things you spawned. It updates by itself every 2 seconds.
section.me: Modes for you only, like flying, invisibility and protection. Each one stays on until you turn it off yourself.
section.health: Heals, revives or cleans you. To treat another player, open their file on the Players page or pick them on the map.

travel.text: Moves you somewhere else fast; the panel closes so you can see your new spot. Your spot is saved before every jump.

section.spawn: Spawns a temporary horse, wagon, animal or person next to you. They belong to nobody and one button removes them all.
section.vehicle: Repairs or fixes the wagon or horse you are using now. You must be on it or close to it.
section.dev: Tools for developers: show and copy coordinates and object IDs, and clear the area around you. The numbers show for you only.

tools.active: The modes that are on for you now. Each stays on until you turn it off here or in the quick menu.

position.text: Where you are now as X, Y and Z. Copy gives you a ready vector3 to paste into a file or a message.

tools.spawned: How many temporary things you have spawned now, out of 25 allowed. At the limit, remove them first, then spawn again.

noclip.text: Fly through walls while hidden and protected. Q goes up, E goes down, Shift is faster. The panel closes so you can move.
noclip.undo: Yes, turn it off here or in the quick menu (F10)

invisible.text: Hides your character from every player, so nobody sees you. Useful while watching or investigating.
invisible.undo: Yes, turn it off any time

godmode.text: Stops all damage to you, so falls and bullets cannot hurt or kill you. Turn it off when you are done.
godmode.undo: Yes, turn it off any time

names.text: Shows the name and session number (#) above every nearby player. Only you see them; players do not know.
names.undo: Yes, turn it off any time

boost.text: Makes you run faster on foot. It does not affect your horse, and only you notice it.
boost.undo: Yes, turn it off any time

stamina.text: Keeps your stamina full so you never tire from running or swimming.
stamina.undo: Yes, turn it off any time

tools.heal: Fills your health, stamina and needs. It does not bring you back from death; use Revive for that.
tools.revive: Brings you back to life where you lie, with full health.
tools.cleanPed: Wipes blood and wetness off your character. Looks only; your health does not change.
tools.refill: Fills your hunger and thirst to 100. Only you are affected.

noclipSpeed.text: How fast Noclip flies. 1x is normal, 0.25x is slow for careful moves and 10x is fast for long trips.

tools.tpWaypoint: Moves you to the waypoint you set on the map, right onto the ground. Set the waypoint first, in the game map or on the Map page here.
tools.tpBack: Takes you back to where you were before your last jump. It stays greyed out until you have jumped once.
tools.tpForward: Moves you onto the nearest surface in front of the camera, like a roof or a rock you are looking at. Handy to get past something.

tpCoords.text: Moves you to a spot by its X, Y and Z numbers. Leave Z empty and we find the ground. You can paste a whole vector3 into any box.

tools.spawnKind: What to spawn: horses, wagons, animals or people. The model list below changes with your choice.

spawnModel.text: Pick the model by name. You can type to search by name or by model name.

tools.mount: On: you get on the horse or wagon as soon as it appears. Off: it waits next to you and you get on yourself.
tools.behavior: What the animal or person does after it appears: Stand stays put and does not attack; Wander walks around freely.
tools.spawn: Spawns the chosen model next to you now; nearby players see it. The limit is 25 temporary things; remove them all with Remove all my spawns.

cleanupSpawned.text: Removes every temporary thing you spawned. Anything a player is riding stays, and players' own horses are never touched.
cleanupSpawned.undo: No, but you can spawn them again

tools.repairVehicle: Repairs the wagon you are in, or the nearest empty one, as good as new.
tools.flipVehicle: Puts an overturned wagon back on its wheels where it is.
tools.vehicleBoost: Gives the wagon you drive a short burst of speed. You must be the driver.
tools.healMount: Restores the health and stamina of the horse you ride now. It cannot bring back a dead horse; the stable does that.
tools.deleteVehicle: Deletes the empty wagon near you (within 6 metres) from the world. Get off it first. Cannot be undone.

laser.text: Shows a laser from the middle of the screen: aim at anything to see its ID, press J to delete it or 7 to copy its details. Players and owned horses are protected.
laser.undo: You can turn the laser off any time, but what it deleted does not come back

showCoords.text: Shows your coordinates and heading on screen, updating as you move. Only you see them.
showCoords.undo: Yes, turn it off any time

hashes.text: Shows the IDs (hashes) of the objects near you on screen. For developers building maps and scripts.
hashes.undo: Yes, turn it off any time

copyCoords3.text: Copies where you stand as a vector3 to paste into a config file or a message. Nothing changes in the game.

copyCoords4.text: Copies your position and heading as a vector4. Handy for spawn points that face a direction.

copyHeading.text: Copies only your character's heading, a number from 0 to 360 degrees.

tools.clearArea: Deletes every unprotected thing around you within the chosen distance: people, animals, wagons and objects, up to 50 at a time. Players, what they ride and stable horses are never touched. Cannot be undone.

radius.text: How many metres around you to clear, from 5 to 100. Example: 30 metres is about a street with its houses.

tools.stopSpectate: Stops watching the player and puts you back where you were before you started watching.
tools.openQuick: Opens the small quick menu at the side of the screen with these same tools, so you can use them while watching the game. Shortcut F10.

lead.me: For you only; they stay on until you turn them off.
lead.travel: The panel closes after a jump so you can see your new spot.
lead.spawn: Temporary staff things that belong to nobody.
lead.dev: The numbers show for you only.

hint.revive: Back to life where you lie
hint.tpWaypoint: Onto the ground at the map waypoint
hint.tpBack: To your spot before the last jump
hint.tpForward: Onto the nearest surface in view
hint.tpCoords: Leave Z empty and we find the ground

hint.repairVehicle: Your wagon or the nearest empty one

tools.paletteOn: On now · press to turn off
tools.paletteForm: Opens My tools to fill in the details

confirm.cleanup: We will remove every temporary thing you spawned. Anything a player is riding stays, and players' horses are never touched.
confirm.deleteVehicle: We will delete the empty wagon near you from the world. Get off it first.
confirm.clearArea: We will delete every unprotected thing within %s metres around you, up to 50 at a time. Players, what they ride and stable horses are never touched.
